appDescription: Symptom Note records strange car sounds together with the vehicle state, finds the conditions in which they repeat, and prepares a report for the repair shop.

function.name: READ_SYMPTOM_SUMMARY
function.description: 증상노트에 정리된 최근 차 소리 증상을 요약해서 읽어 줌 (Read a summary of the recent car sound symptoms: name, count, common conditions, after-repair check).

function.name: HOW_TO_START_RECORDING
function.description: 증상노트로 차 소리 기록을 시작하는 방법을 안내 (Explain how to start recording car sounds with Symptom Note).
